investigations.name: amici
investigations.title: Showcase: viva-amici — AMICI/CVODES compiled ODE integration as a pluggable engine
investigations.description: viva-amici bridges AMICI (the Advanced Multi-language Interface to CVODES/IDAS) into process-bigraph as a process that translates an Antimony model to C++, compiles it, and integrates it with the CVODES stiff solver. This showcase proves the bridge on the simplest possible model — exponential decay — the smoke test that compilation, integration, and emission all work; Lotka-Volterra and a MAPK cascade are available as additional registered composites.
investigations.question: Does viva-amici expose the AMICI simulator (CVODES, with per-model C++ compilation) as a process-bigraph process that compiles an ODE model, integrates it, and emits a correct time-series?
investigations.hypothesis: Wrapping AMICI as a process-bigraph process and running a single-species first-order decay (dA/dt = -kA) should compile the model to native code and integrate it to the analytic solution A(t) = A0*exp(-kt) within solver tolerance, confirming the AMICI->process-bigraph bridge end to end.

investigations.name: artistoo
investigations.title: Reproducing Glazier & Graner (1993) differential-adhesion cell sorting
investigations.description: A reproduction study: run the paper's own surface-tension energies through the real Artistoo CPM (wrapped as pbg-artistoo) and check that the heterotypic boundary fraction moves the way Glazier & Graner (1993) reported for three regimes.
investigations.question:
Does the pbg-artistoo wrapper over the Artistoo Cellular Potts Model reproduce the
differential-adhesion-driven rearrangements of Glazier & Graner (1993) — cell sorting /
engulfment (Fig 12), checkerboard intercalation (Fig 7), and the high-temperature mixing
transition (Fig 9) — from the paper's own surface-tension energies, with no cell motility?
investigations.hypothesis:
Driven only by relative surface tensions gamma (finite-temperature Metropolis dynamics, no
active migration), the heterotypic boundary fraction of a mixed two-type aggregate should FALL
when the heterotypic tension is positive (sorting), RISE when it is negative (checkerboard), and
fail to sort cleanly at high temperature (mixing). Each regime is reproduced by the wrapper's
registered composite for the matching paper figure, robust across seeds.

investigations.name: copasi
investigations.title: Showcase: viva-copasi — COPASI/basico as a pluggable ODE + steady-state engine
investigations.description: viva-copasi bridges COPASI (through the basico Python API) into process-bigraph as three composable units — a steady-state Step, a uniform-time-course Step, and a uniform-time-course Process. This showcase proves the engine on the bundled Elowitz repressilator (BioModels BIOMD0000000012): the steady-state composite is the basic-functionality demonstration, with the UTC process available as a dynamics variant.
investigations.question: Does viva-copasi expose the COPASI simulator (via basico) as reusable process-bigraph Steps/Processes that run a real published gene-circuit model — solving its steady state and integrating its ODE dynamics — end to end?
investigations.hypothesis: Wrapping COPASI as process-bigraph components and loading the bundled Elowitz (2000) repressilator should (a) solve a well-defined steady state whose protein/mRNA stoichiometry and three-fold symmetry match the model's own structure, and (b) integrate the same model forward in time as a genuine oscillator, with both flavors emitting real species concentrations and fluxes.

investigations.name: equilibrator
investigations.title: Showcase: viva-equilibrator — eQuilibrator ΔG' as a pluggable thermodynamics engine
investigations.description: viva-equilibrator bridges the eQuilibrator API (component-contribution ΔG' estimation) into process-bigraph as a reusable thermodynamics Step. This showcase runs the engine on the origin-of-life question of whether early carbon-fixation chemistry is thermodynamically favorable at vent conditions: the feasibility-gate composite computes ΔG' for three reductive CO2-fixation products and emits a per-reaction feasibility flag.
investigations.question: Does viva-equilibrator expose the real eQuilibrator (component-contribution) engine as a process-bigraph Step that computes transformed Gibbs free energies and reports reaction feasibility under defined environmental conditions?
investigations.hypothesis: Wrapping eQuilibrator as a process-bigraph Step and feeding it a fixed alkaline-hydrothermal-vent condition should report that H2-driven reductive CO2-fixation reactions (to formate, acetate, pyruvate) are strongly exergonic (ΔG' < 0) — opening a thermodynamic feasibility gate — using genuine component-contribution estimates, computed entirely offline.

investigations.name: grammar
investigations.title: A human-interpretable grammar as a pluggable rule engine
investigations.description: viva-grammar reimplements the cell-behavior hypothesis grammar (Johnson, Bergman, …, Fertig & Macklin, Cell 2025) as a process-bigraph module. The engine is ABM-agnostic; host coupling lives in thin adapters. This investigation's first study proves the engine on the paper's own hypoxia example; a follow-on will wire the blueprint adapter into viva-multicell-blueprint's CPM / vertex / center-based ABMs.
investigations.question: Can the Macklin/PhysiCell cell-behavior hypothesis grammar be implemented as a generic, ABM-agnostic process that reproduces published multicellular dynamics and plugs into different agent-based models unchanged?
investigations.hypothesis: A clean-room engine that compiles the grammar's rules to the paper's Hill-function mathematics, reading abstract per-cell signals and emitting abstract behaviors, can both (a) reproduce the paper's hypoxia → motility model on a minimal reference substrate and (b) drop into the MISM blueprint's MechanicsBackend in place of its built-in RulesProcess.

investigations.name: maboss
investigations.title: Showcase: viva-maboss — MaBoSS stochastic Boolean networks as a pluggable engine
investigations.description: viva-maboss bridges MaBoSS (via the compiled cmaboss backend) into process-bigraph as a process that advances a continuous-time Boolean network interval by interval, re-sampling the joint state and emitting per-node Boolean state and ensemble on-probability. This showcase proves the engine on a minimal two-node toggle network — the Boolean layer that plugs into multiscale composites (e.g. Boolean cell-fate coupled to kinetics and a spatial field).
investigations.question: Does viva-maboss expose the MaBoSS engine (cmaboss) as a process-bigraph process that advances a stochastic Boolean network one coupling interval at a time and emits ensemble on-probabilities — the Boolean layer for multiscale composites?
investigations.hypothesis: Wrapping MaBoSS as a process-bigraph process and running a two-node network (A activated by B, B repressed by A) should produce bounded, non-degenerate ensemble on-probabilities for both nodes that settle around 0.5 — the signature of the network's limit cycle — using the real cmaboss stochastic simulator.

investigations.name: reactive-system
investigations.title: MAPK signalling as a Bigraphical Reactive System
investigations.description: A single-study demonstration that the Bigraphical Reactive System engine in this workspace reproduces the MAPK signalling cycle from the prior live demo, now runnable and inspectable inside the workbench.
investigations.question:
Can the MAPK signalling cycle be expressed as a Milner-style Bigraphical
Reactive System and reproduce, under Gillespie SSA, the spatial signalling
behaviour of the prior live demo — MEK·ERK complex formation and phospho-ERK
translocation into the nucleus?
investigations.hypothesis:
A single time-stepped BRS process firing seven redex→reactum rewrite rules
over a nested cell bigraph reproduces the qualitative MAPK cycle: complexes
form in the cytoplasm and phospho-ERK accumulates in the nucleus over the run.

investigations.name: tstmd
investigations.title: Cell-ECM mechanical reciprocity (Merks 3D CPM-ECM, 2D real-engine reproduction — FAILS: coupling gap)
investigations.description: A real-engine, 2D reproduction of the mechanical-reciprocity phenomena in a recent (unreleased) 3D cell-ECM model from the Merks lab. The deliverable has two parts: (1) viva-tstmd — a reusable process-bigraph bridge that runs the genuine TST-MD simulator (TST C++ + HOOMD + MUSCLE3) CPU-only inside Docker, with 19 tests; and (2) this investigation, which uses it to measure the paper's observables on real runs. The reproduction currently FAILS its paper-faithful bars — the study tests are intentionally left failing until the cell-ECM coupling and percolation issues are resolved.
investigations.question:
Can we reproduce the cell-ECM mechanical-reciprocity phenomena of Keijzer &
Merks 2026 (arXiv:2609.02375, a 3D hybrid cellular Potts model coupled to a
discrete deformable fiber network — code unreleased) by driving the REAL
published 2D ancestor engine (Tsingos et al. 2023 static-adhesion TST-MD)
on ordinary hardware?
investigations.hypothesis:
The 3D paper extends a published, open 2D engine. Bridged and run CPU-only,
that real engine should reproduce — at the mechanism level, in 2D — the same
reciprocity phenomena: a contractile cell deforms a crosslinked bead-spring
ECM, fibers reorient toward the cell (q/q0 > 1), and crosslinking builds
network connectivity (percolation).
